lines.gurmukhi: ਆਂਧੀ ਪਾਛੇ ਜੋ ਜਲੁ ਬਰਖੈ ਤਿਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਭੀਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: aa(n)dhee paachhe jo jal barakhai tihi teraa jan bheenaa(n) ||
lines.translation: Your servant is drenched with the rain that has fallen in this storm.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਉਦੈ ਭਾਨੁ ਜਬ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੨॥੪੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer man bhaiaa pragaasaa udai bhaan jab cheenaa ||2||43||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, my mind became enlightened, when I saw the sun rise. ||2||43||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee chetee ||
lines.translation: Gauree Chaytee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jas sunahi na har gun gaavahi ||
lines.translation: They do not listen to the Lord's Praises, and they do not sing the Lord's Glories,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਤਨ ਹੀ ਅਸਮਾਨੁ ਗਿਰਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: baatan hee asamaan giraavahi ||1||
lines.translation: but they try to bring down the sky with their talk. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਲੋਗਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: aise logan siu kiaa kaheeai ||
lines.translation: What can anyone say to such people?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਏ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਜ ਤਿਨ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਡਰਾਨੇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo prabh keee bhagat te baahaj tin te sadaa daraane raheeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You should always be careful around those whom God has excluded from His devotional worship. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਦੇਹਿ ਚੁਰੂ ਭਰਿ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap na dehi churoo bhar paanee ||
lines.translation: They do not offer even a handful of water,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਨਿੰਦਹਿ ਜਿਹ ਗੰਗਾ ਆਨੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tih ni(n)dahi jih ga(n)gaa aanee ||2||
lines.translation: while they slander the one who brought forth the Ganges. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੈਠਤ ਉਠਤ ਕੁਟਿਲਤਾ ਚਾਲਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: baithat uthat kutilataa chaalahi ||
lines.translation: Sitting down or standing up, their ways are crooked and evil.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਏ ਅਉਰਨ ਹੂ ਘਾਲਹਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aap gae auran hoo ghaalahi ||3||
lines.translation: They ruin themselves, and then they ruin others. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਾਡਿ ਕੁਚਰਚਾ ਆਨ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhaad kucharachaa aan na jaanahi ||
lines.translation: They know nothing except evil talk.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਹੂ ਕੋ ਕਹਿਓ ਨ ਮਾਨਹਿ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: brahamaa hoo ko kahio na maanahi ||4||
lines.translation: They would not even obey Brahma's orders. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਏ ਅਉਰਨ ਹੂ ਖੋਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap gae auran hoo khovahi ||
lines.translation: They themselves are lost, and they mislead others as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਮੰਦਰ ਮੈ ਸੋਵਹਿ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: aag lagaai ma(n)dar mai sovahi ||5||
lines.translation: They set their own temple on fire, and then they fall asleep within it. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਨ ਹਸਤ ਆਪ ਹਹਿ ਕਾਂਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: avaran hasat aap hahi kaa(n)ne ||
lines.translation: They laugh at others, while they themselves are one-eyed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਲਜਾਨੇ ॥੬॥੧॥੪੪॥
lines.transliteration: tin kau dekh kabeer lajaane ||6||1||44||
lines.translation: Seeing them, Kabeer is embarrassed. ||6||1||44||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ₁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee bairaagani₁ kabeer jee ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree Bairaagan, Kabeer Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਪਿਤਰ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕੋਊ ਮੂਏਂ ਸਿਰਾਧ ਕਰਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevat pitar na maanai kooo mooe(n) siraadh karaahee ||
lines.translation: He does not honor his ancestors while they are alive, but he holds feasts in their honor after they have died.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਤਰ ਭੀ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਊਆ ਕੂਕਰ ਖਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pitar bhee bapure kahu kiu paavahi kaooaa kookar khaahee ||1||
lines.translation: Tell me, how can his poor ancestors receive what the crows and the dogs have eaten up? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mo kau kusal bataavahu koee ||
lines.translation: If only someone would tell me what real happiness is!

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਸਲੁ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਭੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kusal kusal karate jag binasai kusal bhee kaise hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Speaking of happiness and joy, the world is perishing. How can happiness be found? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਟੀ ਕੇ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maatee ke kar devee devaa tis aagai jeeu dehee ||
lines.translation: Making gods and goddesses out of clay, people sacrifice living beings to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਪਿਤਰ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਆਪਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਨ ਲੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aise pitar tumaare kaheeahi aapan kahiaa na lehee ||2||
lines.translation: Such are your dead ancestors, who cannot ask for what they want. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਜੀਉ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਨਿਰਜੀਉ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਕਉ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarajeeu kaatahi nirajeeu poojahi a(n)t kaal kau bhaaree ||
lines.translation: You murder living beings and worship lifeless things; at your very last moment, you shall suffer in terrible pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਭੈ ਡੂਬੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam kee gat nahee jaanee bhai doobe sa(n)saaree ||3||
lines.translation: You do not know the value of the Lord's Name; you shall drown in the terrifying world-ocean. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: devee devaa poojahi dolahi paarabraham nahee jaanaa ||
lines.translation: You worship gods and goddesses, but you do not know the Supreme Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੫॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer akul nahee chetiaa bikhiaa siu lapataanaa ||4||1||45||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, you have not remembered the Lord who has no ancestors; you are clinging to your corrupt ways. ||4||1||45||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee ||
lines.translation: Gauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਮਰੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਐਸੇ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevat marai marai phun jeevai aise su(n)n samaaiaa ||
lines.translation: One who remains dead while yet alive, will live even after death; thus he merges into the Primal Void of the Absolute Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)jan maahi nira(n)jan raheeai bahuR na bhavajal paaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Remaining pure in the midst of impurity, he will never again fall into the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਐਸਾ ਖੀਰੁ ਬਿਲੋਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere raam aisaa kheer biloeeai ||
lines.translation: O my Lord, this is the milk to be churned.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਓਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat manooaa asathir raakhahu in bidh a(n)mrit peeoeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, hold your mind steady and stable, and in this way, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਾਣਿ ਬਜਰ ਕਲ ਛੇਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਪਦੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai baan bajar kal chhedee pragatiaa pad paragaasaa ||
lines.translation: The Guru's arrow has pierced the hard core of this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, and the state of enlightenment has dawned.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਕਤਿ ਅਧੇਰ ਜੇਵੜੀ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਿਵ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sakat adher jevaRee bhram chookaa nihachal siv ghar baasaa ||2||
lines.translation: In the darkness of Maya, I mistook the rope for the snake, but that is over, and now I dwell in the eternal home of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਣੈ ਧਨਖੁ ਚਢਾਈਐ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin bin baanai dhanakh chadhaaeeai ihu jag bedhiaa bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Maya has drawn her bow without an arrow, and has pierced this world, O Siblings of Destiny.
